_doc: Level-2 slice-orchestrator state for ONE slice inside a fleet wave. Reports to CAPTAIN (status only). Location: <repo>/plans/fleet/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<epic>/<wave>/<sliceId>/state.json (RELATIVE to project repo root, committed there). A slice can run for HOURS -> persist every step so resume continues mid-slice. Design ref: pi config docs/design/2026-07-01-fleet-ralph-state-schema.md.
_instantiate: Created by the slice orchestrator on dispatch (copies assignment from Level-1). Updated every step + every assumption/escalation. CRITICAL: partial work must be COMMITTED to the slice branch, not just recorded here.
_escalation_boundary: Technical escalation STOPS at the orchestrator. Only wave/slice STATUS goes up to captain. Orchestrator resolves ambiguity itself + records in assumptions[].

impl._doc: commit-on-meaningful-progress so partial work survives on branch. Resume = checkout branch@lastCommitSha + continue from step.

assumptions.context: what was ambiguous (spec gap / two valid designs)
assumptions._durable_doc: true -> also push to knowledgeDelta[] -> .agents/rules (durable convention). false -> stays here (judgment audit only).
